    Supplement compiler for the bound BGRS Figure 13E diagram #

    The three nonmembership statements printed after Figure 13 in BGRS are supplement statements at the paths alpha tau, tau^2, and tau beta. This file turns exactly those statements into the coherent coefficient data used by Figure13EBoundCoefficientCompiler.

    The middle supplement also kills the line through tau. This chooses the degree-two functional with zero degree-one value. Its translate by multiplication with tau is then the coherent degree-one functional. The two arm supplements kill the duplicated outer occurrences. All remaining whiskering equations follow from endpoint-radical covariance and the local factorization ker(residue) = (-) * tau.
